_about: Hand-kept input to tools/config-reference/generate.py. Each note says where its fact comes from in `source`, a path in flow.service.workflow at the tag. Review every entry at each release: see tools/config-reference/README.md. Links are relative to flow/hosting/.

flow.activation-code.text: Must be at least 32 characters. See [Make the first admin with the activation code](./sign-in#make-the-first-admin-with-the-activation-code).

flow.otc.text: Deprecated: use `flow.activation-code`. Flow reads it only while `flow.activation-code` is unset, and logs a deprecation warning. If both are set and differ, core doesn't start.
flow.otc.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Upgrading (The activation code is FLOW_ACTIVATION_CODE); specifications/authorization.md

flow.security.bootstrap-token.text: Clearing it revokes the bootstrap token at the next start. See [Machine tokens](./machine-tokens).
flow.security.bootstrap-token.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Upgrading (Clearing flow.security.bootstrap-token revokes the bootstrap token)

flow.security.tokens.dispatcher.hash.text: Give every core instance the same `flow.security.tokens` entries: each instance revokes the declared tokens its own configuration doesn't name. See [Machine tokens](./machine-tokens).

mongo.encrypt.secret.text: Read once, by the migration that re-encrypts a v3 install's secured settings. See [Set the encryption keys](./upgrading#set-the-encryption-keys).

spring.mongodb.uri.text: Always set it: the default is a local development sample. See [Connect MongoDB](./configuring#connect-mongodb).

flow.events.sink.enabled.text: `true` sends each run and task run status change to every sink as a CloudEvent. See [Send status events and traces](./configuring#send-status-events-and-traces).

flow.events.sink.destinations[0].types.source: service-core/src/main/resources/application.properties (the Optional filters comment covers the per-destination filters)

flow.artifacts.store.*.source: service-core/src/main/resources/application.properties (the Artifacts comment covers the store properties)

flow.artifacts.upload-grace-minutes.text: How long, in minutes, a partly written upload is kept before Flow deletes it.

logging.level.*.source: service-core/src/main/resources/application.properties (the Spring Logging comment covers every level)

max.*.text: Not read by Flow at this release. Quotas are settings: see [Quotas](./settings-reference#quotas) in All settings.
max.*.source: specifications/architecture.md (Quotas are not a deployment property); no reader in service-core/src/main/java

flow.apps.url.text: Not read by Flow at this release; `flow.apps.flow.url` is.

flow.services.workflow.host.text: Read only through the `flow.workflow.*.url` properties, which start with it.

flow.workflow.webhook.url.text: Every run gets it as the context parameter `webhook-url`: `$(context.params.webhook-url)`.

flow.workflow.event.url.text: Every run gets it as the context parameter `event-url`: `$(context.params.event-url)`.

flow.workflow.wfe.url.text: The wait-for-event route. Every run gets it as the context parameter `wfe-url`: `$(context.params.wfe-url)`.
flow.workflow.wfe.url.source: specifications/parameters.md (Run context); CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 (The wfe-url context param)

flow.error.include-cause.text: `true` adds the underlying exception to an error response, as `cause`.

kube.namespace.text: When neither resolves, the dispatcher doesn't start.

kube.image.pullSecret.text: The image pull secret on every task pod this deployment runs.

kube.timeout.waitUntil.text: Seconds the dispatcher waits for a new run workspace claim to reach `Pending` or `Bound`.

kube.task.backOffLimit.text: Set on each Job, with the `kube-jobs` executor.

kube.task.restartPolicy.text: Set on each Job, with the `kube-jobs` executor.

kube.task.ttlDays.text: A finished Job or TaskRun is removed this many days after it completes, whatever the deletion policy. See [Clean up finished tasks](./dispatcher#clean-up-finished-tasks).

kube.task.deletion.text: Never applies: core sends every task with the **Tasks › Deletion Policy** setting, and this is only its fallback. See [Tasks](./settings-reference#tasks) in All settings.

kube.task.timeout.text: Minutes. The per-pod backstop for a task that reaches the dispatcher with no timeout, or 0. A timeout core sets wins.

kube.task.storage.data.memory.text: `true` backs a task's `/data` with memory, for a task whose `worker.storage.data.memory` param is also `true`.

dispatcher.tasks.serviceaccount.text: Set on Jobs only, with the `kube-jobs` executor.

dispatcher.tasks.nodeselector.text: Applied to every task pod this deployment runs.

dispatcher.tasks.tolerations.text: Applied to every task pod this deployment runs. Empty entries are dropped.

dispatcher.tasks.hostaliases.text: Applied to every task pod this deployment runs. Empty entries are dropped.

dispatcher.logging.type.text: `default` reads a running task's log from its pod; `loki` queries Loki at `dispatcher.logging.host` and `dispatcher.logging.port`.

proxy.enable.text: `true` passes `PROXY_HOST`, `PROXY_PORT`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY`, and their lower-case forms, to every task container.

flow.version.text: Passed to every task container as `FLOW_VERSION`.

flow.dispatcher.name.text: The name the dispatcher registers with.

flow.dispatcher.ai.otel.headers.source: service-dispatcher/src/main/resources/application.properties (headers that may carry credentials, like the token)

oidc.issuer.text: Seeded at start from the property `flow.auth.oidc.issuer` while blank. A value set here is never overwritten by the property. See [Sign in with OpenID Connect](./sign-in#sign-in-with-openid-connect).

oidc.clientId.text: Seeded at start from the property `flow.auth.oidc.client-id` while blank, as **OIDC Issuer** is.

logs.enabled.text: Logs are stored only while the artifact store is on (`flow.artifacts.enabled`).

retentionDays.applies: within about a minute, on every instance.

workspaceQuotas.text: The only switch for quotas: no property turns them off. See [Turn quotas off](../webapp/quotas#turn-quotas-off).
workspaceQuotas.source: specifications/architecture.md (Quotas are not a deployment property)

workflowTokens.text: Has no effect while Flow runs with security off (`flow.security.enabled=false`).

workspaceManagement.text: Off, whatever its value, while `flow.workspace.single` is `true`.

userManagement.text: Off, whatever its value, while `flow.workspace.single` is `true`.

workspaceCreate.text: Off, whatever its value, while `flow.workspace.single` is `true`.
workspaceCreate.applies: to sessions signed in after the change.

slack.clientId.text: The Integrations page lists Slack once **Slack Client ID** and **Slack Client Secret** are set.

slack.signingSecret.text: With none set, Flow refuses every request to its Slack commands, interactivity and events routes.
slack.signingSecret.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Upgrading (The inbound Slack routes require Slack's request signature)

github.webhookSecret.text: With none set, Flow refuses every GitHub event with `401`.
github.webhookSecret.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Upgrading (Every GitHub App delivery requires GitHub's signature)

max.workspace.storage.text: Also the size a run workspace gets when its workflow leaves the size blank, lowered to the workspace's own storage quota when that's smaller.

default.image.text: A `template` or `script` task without an image of its own runs on it. See [Set the task image](./configuring#set-the-task-image).
default.image.applies: when a run is queued: a run already queued keeps the value it was queued with.
default.image.source: specifications/dispatcher-contract.md (task types); CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Changed (A task run takes the task settings when the run is queued)

deletion.policy.applies: when a run is queued: a run already queued keeps the value it was queued with.
deletion.policy.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Changed; specifications/data-model.md (task settings read at queue)

default.timeout.applies: when a run is queued: a run already queued keeps the value it was queued with.
default.timeout.source: CHANGELOG.md 5.0.0 Changed; specifications/data-model.md (task settings read at queue)

retention.days.applies: at the next hourly purge pass, which reads it.
retention.days.source: specifications/data-model.md (Artifacts: finished runs are kept for retention.days, read at each pass; an hourly pass)
